question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Ignorance is bliss

options.text: To gain attention and be the topic of conversation
To remain ignorant of things that may cause stress
To want something that has been denied
To have rage underneath a calm expression

solution:
The correct answer is: **To remain ignorant of things that may cause stress**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom "**Ignorance is bliss**" means that it is pleasant not to know about something because then you do not worry about it. (किसी चीज के बारे में न जानना सुखद है क्योंकि तब आप उसके बारे में चिंता नहीं करते।)

 
 
• Example -* **When it comes to what my kids end up eating at their grandparents' house, **ignorance is bliss**.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Ignorance is bliss**" is "**To remain ignorant of things that may cause stress**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
